answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 37437 Country: India Title: Is it compulsory to wash the area under chin during wudhu Question: Is it compulsory to wash the area under chin during wudhu? If masah of head is done without taking fresh water although it is done by wet hands as water remains then is there any harm on performed wudhu? Answer ID: 37437 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 405/337/B=1433) Yes, it is necessary to wash the area under chin during wudhu. If one did masah without taking fresh water then too masah was valid. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
